focus: Source contracts, captured identity, ownership and scope

findings.issue: Numeric table events can outlive report generation replacement.
findings.resolution: Generation-bound full finding/duplicate row identities and active-instance guards required.

findings.issue: Home generation reset can overwrite desired jump; ScreenResume runs within pop.
findings.resolution: Consume queued handoff in common resume path and apply target after generation rebuild, before final cursor/preview synchronization.

findings.issue: Doctor could accidentally be routed as a computed report screen.
findings.resolution: Explicit sync-only app integration; no worker messages or controller/report type expansion.
